        "source_validity": "valid",
        "source_system": "field_inspection_registry",
        "source_table": "area_measurements",
        "source_record_ref": "area_measurements:INSP-20250318-TG:KTV_ROOM_FINAL（允许同批次的 VALID_FINAL / final_valid_included_ktv_rooms / room_composition 等稳定逻辑引用）",
        "reviewed_by_org_id": "ORG-JS-WLTS-001",
        "package_measured_area_claim_count_after": 2
      },
      "description": "归档包中新增一条有效、已复核的包间面积构成主张，并绑定案件、稳定主体场所及现场测量来源。"
    },
    {
      "id": "room_aggregation",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "是否从有效最终包间测量记录正确算出包间数量、完整房号集合和合计面积？",
      "pass_anchor": "真实现场检查批次 INSP-20250318-TG 按最终、有效的 KTV 包间记录聚合：共 8 间，房号完整集合为 A01、A02、A03、A05、A06、A08、A09、A10，合计 206.6 平方米；应排除 A05 的历史替代记录以及汇总草稿等非最终记录。数值容差 ±0.1 平方米，房号集合需完整且不多不少。"
    },
    {
      "id": "area_distinction",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "是否正确区分包间构成主张、公示经营面积和现场经营总面积，并说明新主张不是替换关系？",
      "pass_anchor": "应明确：1907号案件已有公示经营面积为 298.0 平方米，已有现场有效分区测量汇总的经营总面积为 298.6 平方米；新增 206.6 平方米只是 8 间包间的构成子集/结构证据，不是经营总面积，也不覆盖、删除或改写 298.0 或 298.6。数值容差 ±0.1 平方米。"
    },
    {
      "id": "operation_report",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "是否在最终回复中准确报告了实际发布操作及新增主张的关键归档信息？",
      "pass_anchor": "最终回复应说明已向已归档现场核查包 EPKG-2025-1907-INS-V1、案件 CASE-2025-ENT-0318-01907 发布新的 measured_area 包间构成主张，数值为 206.6 sqm，状态为 valid/reviewed；应提到沿用稳定申请人 APPLICANT-JS-TG-1907 和同一场所的稳定标识（归档库别名 VENUE-JS-TG-1907 或审批库地址标识 ADDR-ZJ-JX-JS-TCL2-302-3），关联现场批次 INS-2025-ENT-0318-01907/原始测量来源，并说明使用幂等/可重试发布。公示编号可按审批库 1907 或归档库 NOTICE-1907 表达，允许用自然语言表达同一事实。"
    },
    {
      "id": "protected_claims",
      "tier": "sanity",
      "method": "rule",
      "fn": "check_protected_claims",
      "ground_truth": {
        "original_case_claim_count": 10,
        "published_claim_id": "CLM-1907-AREA-PUB-003",
        "published_claim_value_num": 298,
        "measured_total_claim_id": "CLM-1907-AREA-MEA-004",
        "measured_total_claim_value_num": 298.6,
        "measured_total_claim_type": "measured_area",
        "historical_rejected_claim_id": "CLM-HIST-2019-1907-010"
      },
      "description": "不得改写既有公示面积、现场经营总面积或历史审计留痕；新增主张的存在和归档包计数由 critical rule 验证。",
      "weight": 0
    }
  ],
  "check_code": "import sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nCASE_ID = \"CASE-2025-ENT-0318-01907\"\nPACKAGE_ID = \"EPKG-2025-1907-INS-V1\"\n\ndef _db(ws):\n    return Path(ws).parent / \"system\" / \"permit_evidence_knowledge\" / \"state.db\"\n\ndef _rows(ws, sql, params=()):\n    con = sqlite3.connect(_db(ws))\n    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    try:\n        return [dict(row) for row in con.execute(sql, params)]\n    finally:\n        con.close()\n\ndef check_published_room_claim(ws):\n    rows = _rows(ws, \"\"\"\n        SELECT * FROM evidence_claims\n        WHERE evidence_package_id=? AND case_id=? AND claim_type='measured_area'\n          AND ABS(COALESCE(claim_value_num, -999999) - 206.6) < 0.0001\n          AND claim_unit='sqm'\n          AND claim_status='reviewed' AND source_validity='valid'\n    \"\"\", (PACKAGE_ID, CASE_ID))\n    if len(rows) != 1:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"expected exactly one new 206.6 sqm measured_area claim, found {len(rows)}\"}\n    row = rows[0]\n    checks = {\n        \"inspection_id\": row[\"inspection_id\"] == \"INS-2025-ENT-0318-01907\",\n        \"applicant_id\": row[\"applicant_id\"] == \"APPLICANT-JS-TG-1907\",\n        \"venue_id\": row[\"venue_id\"] in {\"VENUE-JS-TG-1907\", \"ADDR-ZJ-JX-JS-TCL2-302-3\"},\n        \"public_notice_no\": row[\"public_notice_no\"] in {\"NOTICE-1907\", \"1907\"},\n        \"source_system\": row[\"source_system\"] == \"field_inspection_registry\",\n        \"source_table\": row[\"source_table\"] == \"area_measurements\",\n        \"source_ref\": (\n            isinstance(row[\"source_record_ref\"], str)\n            and row[\"source_record_ref\"].lower().startswith(\"area_measurements:\")\n            and (\"insp-20250318-tg\" in row[\"source_record_ref\"].lower()\n                 or \"ins-2025-ent-0318-01907\" in row[\"source_record_ref\"].lower())\n            and (\"room\" in row[\"source_record_ref\"].lower()\n                 or \"ktv\" in row[\"source_record_ref\"].lower())\n            and (\"final\" in row[\"source_record_ref\"].lower()\n                 or \"composition\" in row[\"source_record_ref\"].lower())\n        ),\n        \"reviewed_org\": row[\"reviewed_by_org_id\"] == \"ORG-JS-WLTS-001\",\n    }\n    package_count = _rows(ws, \"SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM evidence_claims WHERE evidence_package_id=? AND claim_type='measured_area'\", (PACKAGE_ID,))[0][\"n\"]\n    checks[\"package_count\"] = package_count == 2\n    failed = [key for key, ok in checks.items() if not ok]\n    return {\"score\": 0 if failed else 1, \"detail\": \"failed: \" + \", \".join(failed) if failed else \"new reviewed valid room-composition claim is correct\"}\n\ndef check_protected_claims(ws):\n    rows = _rows(ws, \"\"\"\n        SELECT claim_id, claim_type, claim_value_num, claim_status, source_validity\n        FROM evidence_claims WHERE case_id=?\n    \"\"\", (CASE_ID,))\n    by_id = {row[\"claim_id\"]: row for row in rows}\n    checks = {\n        \"published_exists\": \"CLM-1907-AREA-PUB-003\" in by_id,\n        \"published_value\": \"CLM-1907-AREA-PUB-003\" in by_id and abs(by_id[\"CLM-1907-AREA-PUB-003\"][\"claim_value_num\"] - 298.0) < 0.0001,\n        \"measured_total_exists\": \"CLM-1907-AREA-MEA-004\" in by_id,\n        \"measured_total_value\": \"CLM-1907-AREA-MEA-004\" in by_id and abs(by_id[\"CLM-1907-AREA-MEA-004\"][\"claim_value_num\"] - 298.6) < 0.0001,\n        \"measured_total_type\": \"CLM-1907-AREA-MEA-004\" in by_id and by_id[\"CLM-1907-AREA-MEA-004\"][\"claim_type\"] == \"measured_area\",\n        \"history_preserved\": \"CLM-HIST-2019-1907-010\" in by_id and by_id[\"CLM-HIST-2019-1907-010\"][\"claim_status\"] == \"rejected\" and by_id[\"CLM-HIST-2019-1907-010\"][\"source_validity\"] == \"source_unavailable\",\n    }\n    failed = [key for key, ok in checks.items() if not ok]\n    return {\"score\": 0 if failed else 1, \"detail\": \"failed: \" + \", \".join(failed) if failed else \"protected historical and area claims remain unchanged\"}\n",
  "gold_answer": null,
  "input": "both",
  "act": "mutate_db",
  "output": "none",
  "reward": "rl_grade"
}

rationale: Zero reward weight for rules measured passing on pristine state; keep the checks and failure reports.
